title: US 75 photos Richardson Plano
text: On July 31, 2026, the structures of the aesthetic arches at the DART Silver Line crossing were completed. Remaining work included light installation. The cost of the arches was reported to be around $44 million, with $16 million covered by DART and $28 million covered by the City of Richardson.
